items.name: 0db
items.title: 0dB
items.description: 0dB tokens, the default font pair, the reset and the base pieces, with a Tailwind v4 theme bridge.

items.name: fonts-press
items.title: Pair: press
items.description: Schibsted Grotesk and Newsreader, for <html data-pair="press">.

items.name: fonts-paris
items.title: Pair: paris
items.description: Instrument Sans and EB Garamond, for <html data-pair="paris">.

items.name: fonts-salon
items.title: Pair: salon
items.description: Bricolage Grotesque and Cormorant, for <html data-pair="salon">.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: A hairline underline at rest; pointing at it, focusing it or holding its card open draws a highlighter stroke through the whole word, on from the left and off to the right.

items.name: meta
items.title: Meta
items.description: A frame row: small words held apart by hairlines that stretch to fill the row.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A key, drawn as a ring. Pressed, it shrinks a little and the ring turns to ink.

items.name: corners
items.title: Corners
items.description: Four corner marks: a frame that doesn't close.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: One family of three (a statement in an ink block, a bracket that steps apart, a quiet line that redraws) and four heroes for the big call to action: overture, fermata, stave and ink. Nothing moves its neighbours.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Three periods breathing in turn, always beside the words that say what's happening.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: No box. The words are the control, and checking strikes them through in the accent.

items.name: fraction
items.title: Fraction
items.description: A count set as a display fraction with a leaning hairline. The part that's yours is italic.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: Words in a row. The one you choose turns italic, because it's yours now, and one dot glides beneath it, stretching as it travels.

items.name: dial
items.title: Dial
items.description: A radio for numbers, set on an arc. The whole dial rolls to what you choose: the number swells and turns italic, and the dot travels the arc.

items.name: picks
items.title: Picks
items.description: A list of choices that carry their own content. A dot hangs beside the one you took; pointing at another shows a ring where it would land.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A sentence whose last word you can change. The state rolls between on and off in italic, and the full stop answers: a dot when on, a ring when off.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A ruler with a hand. The value is drawn as a dimension: a line from zero to the hand, with your number, in italic, in the gap.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: No box, only a baseline. Your words arrive in italic, focus draws the accent from where you touched, and an error hangs from the line as a callout.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A choice set inside a sentence: the chosen word is yours, italic over a hairline, with a small arrow that drops when you point at it.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Words with their counts raised. A line inches to the one in view, leading edge first, and the count of what's showing sinks into the rule.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Numbers with a dot beneath each. The current page's dot is the accent, and weight falls away with distance from it.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: The path, divided by drawn hairlines leaning like slashes. Point at a step and the two beside it lean in to hold it.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Questions ruled off in a stack; a plus that turns into a cross as each one opens.

items.name: rows
items.title: Rows
items.description: An index of hairline-separated rows. The one you point at reverses out of ink and steps forward with an arrow.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month of dots: past days filled, today in the accent, days to come as rings. The day you choose shows its number in italic.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: The one rounded shape: a hairline pill for a tag or a status.

items.name: note
items.title: Note
items.description: Marginalia: a dotted term, and a leader line that draws out to its note.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A hairline that fills, and the percentage set as an italic numeral.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: One line rises from the bottom-left; a fermata arc beneath it empties while it stays.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: The question, set large, with two plain answers. The page holds still behind it.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: An invitation to act, not an apology: what is missing, and the one thing to do about it.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A word you can hold down. Held, it wears the fermata: an arc rises over the word, then a dot lands inside it.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: Words held apart by standing hairlines; a group can allow one held word or many.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: One pair of parentheses holds a set of actions, and hairlines stand between them.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input group
items.description: Ours in roman, yours in italic, on one line. The accent draws only under the part you type.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A one-time code on short baselines, three and three. Digits drop in as you type; whole, the lines ink in turn.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A field that suggests. Type and the letters you typed are marked in each match, the suggestions arrive in turn, and what you chose sits on the line in italic.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A panel hung from what opened it, on a leader line. Escape or a click elsewhere puts it away.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context menu
items.description: The same list of words, opened where you pressed and spreading from that point like ink.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: A list of words on the popover panel; the one you point at is marked with the highlighter.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A frame row of words along a hairline; each opens a menu, and a stroke slides to the open one.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation menu
items.description: Small words open a panel of large names, the scale contrast of a poster.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: What you type is set as large as a headline, in italic. Matches are marked; the chosen row steps forward.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A column of words beside the work. Folded, it becomes a ruler: a numeral for each group, a tick for each link, and the name comes out into the margin when you point at it.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A column under a rule, not a box. Point at it and an ink stroke passes along the rule.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover card
items.description: Point at a name and wait a moment: a card opens with the name set large and cropped by its edge.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A whisper in parentheses above the thing it names.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A page slid in from the edge, its title running up the spine like a book's.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A sheet from below, lifted by the fermata's arc. Drag the arc down to put it away.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A list that ends in the rest of itself: the words "and 4 more" are the control.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panes and the rule between them. Take the rule and it inks; while you hold it, each pane's share is drawn as a dimension.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: A rule appears at an edge only while there's more beyond it, and leaves when you reach the end.

items.name: scrollbar
items.title: Scrollbar
items.description: A scrollbar as a ruler: a hairline, a mark where each section begins, and an ink thumb as long as the view.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect ratio
items.description: A frame kept to a ratio and marked the way a printer marks a crop: short lines outside each corner, never a border.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: One poster at a time, each name set so large the frame crops it. The count between the arrows rolls the way you travel.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Hairline rows in tabular figures; the column you sort by is set in ink.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Hairlines and dots against one very large number that rolls to the bar you point at.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person is a ring and their initial, in italic, since a name is theirs.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A ledger line: what it is, a dotted leader, what you can do. Point at it and the leader inks across.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: Long text, set to be read: it styles plain HTML by element, and punctuation hangs in the margin.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: No balloons. Of the speech bubble only its tail is left, a leaning hairline. What they wrote is roman; what you wrote sits on the other side, in italic.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: A quiet line in a conversation: a status, or where a day begins.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file's extension is its picture; a ring counts it in and fills to a dot when it's safe.

items.name: thread
items.title: Thread
items.description: A message scroller that keeps to the latest while you are at the end. Scrolled back, it stays put and counts what is new in an ink pill.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: Questions one at a time, set large. The count rolls and a hairline fills; each question turns in from the side you're heading. At the end your answers are written into one sentence, in italic, arriving word by word.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A double bar: in a score, the sign that something changes here.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Baselines where the words will be. Still until something is loading, and still when motion is off.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: A date inside a sentence, like the select. It opens the month on a leader line; choose a day and it is written into the sentence in italic.

items.name: calligram
items.title: Calligram
items.description: A paragraph that fills a shape, as Apollinaire's calligrams did: each line is as wide as the shape is at that height, so the outline is only implied.

items.name: command-line
items.title: Command line
items.description: One line to type, on a baseline like a field already filled in. The address recedes, the part that's yours is italic, and copying draws the line in the accent.

items.name: contour
items.title: Contour
items.description: A paragraph set to a contour, the way a score draws a swell: each line laid to its own width, so the words taper, open or swell and close.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: Fields on the grid and one statement button. A failed send gives each field its callout and focuses the first; while sending, the button says so.

items.name: gather
items.title: Gather
items.description: A line whose letters start as dust and settle into place as it scrolls into view, then give way to the real text.

items.name: measure
items.title: Measure
items.description: A paragraph whose measure you set by dragging its right edge, with the number of characters a line and a verdict on it.

items.name: melody
items.title: Melody
items.description: A sentence set on a stave, each word a note. Point at one and the phrase plays from it.

items.name: mode-toggle
items.title: Mode toggle
items.description: The way from day to night. One button, pressed at night, drawn five ways: a disc sliding over a ring, a dot setting below a hairline, two words with one struck through, the fermata as an eye, or a sentence whose last word rolls.

items.name: reverb
items.title: Reverb
items.description: A phrase that echoes into silence: each line quieter, more open and a dynamic smaller, drifting right like a canon, ending on a rest.

items.name: source
items.title: Source
items.description: Code, set as type. Weight is the only highlighting, what someone wrote is italic, and a bracket joins the lines like a system in a score.

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: A real sequence, numbered in large thin figures, with the current one in the accent.

items.name: wake
items.title: Wake
items.description: A paragraph that parts around your pointer like water around a hand: the lines it crosses split in two and the words move on.

items.name: waterfall
items.title: Waterfall
items.description: A type specimen waterfall: one sentence at every dynamic, loudest first, each line filled to the measure with as many whole words as the size holds.
